name: Which observed evidence helps the task
summary: Picks the evidence candidate most relevant to a stated task, from the ones the host observed, or none, and asks whether the set plausibly covers the task's needs.

most_relevant.instructions: Which candidate is most relevant to the task the state describes? Choose only among the listed options - every one is a path the host already observed, listed with the line span it covers when it covers one, how much of its content was admitted, and its size in bytes. A refused candidate is a name the host recorded without reading a byte of it, so its path and span are all there is to judge. Judge only what the state shows and never assume content a candidate does not carry. Answer none when no listed candidate would help the task.

criteria.none: No listed candidate is relevant to this task. The paths the host observed do not reach what the task turns on.

any_relevant.instructions: At least one of the listed candidates is relevant evidence for the task the state describes.

coverage.instructions: The listed candidates plausibly cover the task's needs: the state names no region or kind of evidence the task turns on that the list misses.
